title: Pivot app to minimal landing page showing only “Iman limbu”

requirements.text: Change the browser tab/page title to exactly "Iman limbu".

quotes: Make website when website opens only see my name Iman limbu and website name Iman limbu

acceptanceCriteria: In frontend/index.html, the <title> text is exactly "Iman limbu".
After loading the site, the browser tab title shows "Iman limbu".

requirements.text: Replace the current app UI with a minimal landing page so that on initial load the only visible on-page text is exactly "Iman limbu" (no buttons, no chat UI, no footer text, no other labels).

quotes: Make website when website opens only see my name Iman limbu and website name Iman limbu

acceptanceCriteria: On first load, the page shows only one visible text element and it reads exactly: "Iman limbu".
There are no other visible UI elements such as login buttons, headers, footers, chat thread, settings, avatars, or descriptive paragraphs.
The displayed "Iman limbu" text is centered on the page (horizontally and vertically) and remains readable in both light and dark mode.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify immutable hook/provider files (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Backend must remain single-actor; do not introduce additional canisters/services.
nonGoals: Implementing or preserving the AI companion chat experience (message thread, typing indicator, reply engine).
Internet Identity authentication UI/flows for this landing page.
Persisting or displaying any user profile or conversation data on this landing page.
